concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-marketplaces-top-up-balance-account]] — 2026-09-15 Marketplace overview defining user/liable balance-account top-ups as incoming external transfers and routing scheduled, on-demand and webhook detail; initiation is not booked-credit proof.
warnings: The page's pull-sweep/verified-instrument description is narrower than its body, which covers both scheduled and on-demand top-ups; use child guides for method-specific requirements.
Initiation is distinct from external debit finality, booked balance-account credit, available balance or bank payout.
